provenance.paper_title: ViLoMem: Agentic Learner with Grow-and-Refine Multimodal Semantic Memory

evidence.paraphrase: Visual-distraction and logical-reasoning error schemas are grown and refined from successes and failures.
During operation, ViLoMem applies LLM-mediated memory editing to dual-stream semantic memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, ViLoMem applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to dual-stream semantic memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Task outcomes are abstracted into reusable semantic strategies and error schemas. For ViLoMem, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of dual-stream semantic memory.
New evidence refines previously stored semantic knowledge. For ViLoMem, this specifically supports LLM-based resolution of conflicting records of dual-stream semantic memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (dual-stream semantic memory) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, LLM-based resolution of conflicting records; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
